caption:
Legs aching when you walk, but easing as soon as you sit down?

That pattern is often linked to narrowing around the nerves in the lower back, sometimes called spinal stenosis. Leaning forward, like on a shopping trolley, usually opens up a bit more space and brings relief.

Current guidelines suggest exercise as a first step. Walking in shorter bouts with rests, cycling and building hip and leg strength can make daily life more comfortable. Poor circulation can feel similar, so it's worth an assessment. Numbness in the groin, bladder or bowel changes, or worsening weakness need a doctor promptly.

Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can help. Book online via the link in bio.
